Tooltip_EmptyBloodBag: Empty sterile blood collection bag. <LINE> Can be used to draw and store your own blood. <LINE> Requires 80%+ blood volume to donate safely. <LINE> Creates a blood bag matching your blood type. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> Freeze filled bags for storage!
Tooltip_IVKit: Complete IV administration kit with tubing, needles, and connectors. <LINE> Required for administering IV medications. <LINE> Single use - consumed on use.
Tooltip_Syringe: Sterile disposable syringe. <LINE> Required for injectable medications. <LINE> Single use - consumed on use.
Tooltip_SterilizedBandages: Sealed pack of clean bandages. <LINE> Applies as a normal clean bandage. <LINE> Holds up to 5 clean bandages. <LINE> Does not disinfect wounds.
Tooltip_AlchoholicBandage: Alcohol-prepared clean bandage. <LINE> Cleans the wound and applies a clean bandage in one use.
Tooltip_Epinephrine: Emergency epinephrine auto-injector. <LINE> Treats severe allergic reactions and cardiac arrest. <LINE> Can revive unconscious patients.
Tooltip_ColdFluTablets: Over-the-counter cold and flu relief. <LINE> Reduces fever, fatigue, and minor pain. <LINE> Does NOT cure - symptom relief only (40%).
Tooltip_AntipyreticTablets: Fever-reducing tablets. <LINE> Can reduce illness-related fever to 37.0 C. <LINE> Does NOT cool environmental overheating.
Tooltip_CoughSyrup: Liquid cough medicine. <LINE> Suppresses cough reflex - good for stealth! <LINE> Reduces coughing by 50%. Does NOT cure.
Tooltip_ElectrolytePowder: Electrolyte replacement powder - mix with water. <LINE> Treats dehydration from dysentery, heat, or vomiting. <LINE> 40% symptom relief. Does NOT cure.
Tooltip_BronchodilatorInhaler: Inhaler for respiratory distress. <LINE> Opens airways - helps with pneumonia and corpse sickness. <LINE> 45% breathing improvement. Does NOT cure.
Tooltip_AntiNauseaTablets: Anti-nausea medication. <LINE> Greatly reduces nausea and vomiting from food poisoning, dysentery, or corpse sickness. <LINE> Symptom relief. Does NOT cure.
Tooltip_AntiInflammatory: Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory pills. <LINE> Reduces swelling, pain, and mild illness-related fever. <LINE> Strong symptom relief. Does NOT cure.
Tooltip_AntiDiarrheal: Anti-diarrheal tablets. <LINE> Strongly relieves dysentery diarrhea and urgency. <LINE> Temporarily suppresses hunger/thirst caps. Does NOT cure.
Tooltip_MuscleRelaxants: Over-the-counter muscle relaxants. <LINE> Eases muscle spasms from tetanus or parasites. <LINE> 40% spasm reduction. Does NOT cure.
Tooltip_NitricOxideBooster: Performance booster tablets. <LINE> Locks endurance at 100% for 3 hours. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECT AFTER USE: Whole-body muscle pain for 6 hours.
Tooltip_CaffeinePills: Strong caffeine pills. <LINE> Removes fatigue and prevents fatigue gain for 12 hours. <LINE> Prevents sleep while active. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> CRASH: maximum fatigue when it wears off.
Tooltip_PillsSleeping: Sleeping tablets. <LINE> Uses vanilla sleep behavior. <LINE> EHR tracks remaining doses and active duration.
Tooltip_CoughSuppressant: Cough suppressant tablets. <LINE> Reduces urge to cough - avoid attracting zombies! <LINE> 45% cough reduction. Does NOT cure.
Tooltip_AntisepticCream: Prescription antiseptic cream. <LINE> Apply to active wounds to prevent infection. <LINE> 100% wound infection prevention while active. Does NOT cure established infections.
Tooltip_AntiviralCapsules: Prescription antiviral medication. <LINE> CURES viral infections (cold, gastroenteritis). <LINE> Treatment time: 48 hours.
Tooltip_PrescriptionAntibiotics: Strong prescription antibiotics. <LINE> CURES bacterial infections (wounds, cellulitis, pneumonia). <LINE> Treatment time: 72 hours.
Tooltip_AntifungalTablets: Oral antifungal medication. <LINE> CURES cadaveric aspergillosis. <LINE> Treatment time: 5 days.
Tooltip_ActivatedCharcoal: Medical-grade activated charcoal. <LINE> Absorbs toxins - CURES food poisoning and toxin poisoning. <LINE> Treatment time: food poisoning 6h, toxin poisoning 12h.
Tooltip_AntiparasiticPills: Antiparasitic medication. <LINE> CURES parasitic infections (trichinosis, hyperkeratotic scabies). <LINE> Treatment time: 7 days.
Tooltip_TopicalPermethrin: Topical permethrin cream. <LINE> CURES hyperkeratotic scabies over a 6-dose course. <LINE> Treatment time: 72 hours. <LINE> Reduces itching, fever and health loss while active.
Tooltip_OralRehydrationKit: Medical rehydration solution kit. <LINE> CURES dehydration-based conditions (dysentery, heat exhaustion). <LINE> Treatment time: 48 hours, 8-dose course.
Tooltip_InstantIcePack: Emergency instant cooling pack box. <LINE> CURES heat stroke with a 4-dose cooling course. <LINE> Reduces fever, confusion, collapse risk, dehydration and health loss.
Tooltip_Furosemide: Loop diuretic for severe transfusion reactions. <LINE> CURES acute hemolytic transfusion reaction over a 6-dose course. <LINE> Treatment time: 48 hours. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Dehydration, Lower Back Pain, Diuretic Effect
Tooltip_Antipsychotics: Prescription antipsychotic medication. <LINE> CURES delirium over an 8-dose course. <LINE> Treatment time: 96 hours.
Tooltip_TetanusAntitoxin: Tetanus antitoxin injection. <LINE> Neutralizes tetanus toxin - CURES tetanus. <LINE> Requires syringe. Treatment time: 5 days.
Tooltip_TBAntibiotics: Isoniazid - first-line TB treatment. <LINE> CURES tuberculosis with prolonged treatment. <LINE> Treatment time: 21 days (TB is chronic).
Tooltip_AntibioticOintment: Prescription antibiotic ointment. <LINE> CURES skin infections (wounds, cellulitis). <LINE> Topical application. Treatment time: 72 hours.
Tooltip_BroadSpectrumAntibiotics: Broad spectrum antibiotic pills. <LINE> CURES multiple bacterial infections including pneumonia, dysentery and sepsis. <LINE> Treatment time: 72 hours.
Tooltip_PlantBasedAntibiotics: Plant-based broad spectrum antibiotics. <LINE> CURES multiple bacterial infections including pneumonia, dysentery and sepsis. <LINE> Treatment time: 72 hours. <LINE> Crafted with fresh medicinal herbs.
Tooltip_EhrRecipePlantBasedAntibiotics: Recipe notes for preparing plant-based antibiotics. <LINE> Teaches: Plant-Based Antibiotics. <LINE> First Aid 8 can craft this without reading.
Tooltip_CorticosteroidInjection: Hospital-grade corticosteroid injection. <LINE> FAST CURE for severe corpse airway irritation (12hrs). <LINE> Requires syringe. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Immunosuppression, Insomnia
Tooltip_RespiratorySupportKit: Portable oxygen and airway support kit. <LINE> FAST CURE for corpse sickness (6hrs). <LINE> Strong breathing, dizziness, nausea and weakness relief. <LINE> 3 uses per kit, one dose every 3 hours.
Tooltip_IVFluids: Intravenous fluid support. <LINE> FAST CURE for acute transfusion reaction (24hrs). <LINE> Strong hydration and health-loss relief. <LINE> Requires IV Kit.
Tooltip_IVAntibiotics: Intravenous antibiotic solution. <LINE> FAST CURE for severe infections, including dysentery (36hrs). <LINE> Requires IV Kit. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Nausea, Fatigue
Tooltip_IVMetronidazole: IV Metronidazole for anaerobic bacteria. <LINE> FAST CURE for dysentery and sepsis (24hrs). <LINE> Requires IV Kit. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Metallic Taste, Nausea
Tooltip_IVAmphotericin: IV Amphotericin B - powerful antifungal. <LINE> FAST CURE for severe cadaveric aspergillosis (24hrs). <LINE> Requires IV Kit. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Fever, Kidney Stress, Fatigue
Tooltip_ChelationKit: Chelation therapy kit for heavy metal poisoning. <LINE> Removes heavy metals from the bloodstream (24hrs). <LINE> Requires IV Kit. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Headache, Fatigue, Nausea
Tooltip_AlbendazoleInjection: Injectable Albendazole antiparasitic. <LINE> FAST CURE for severe parasitic infections (72hrs). <LINE> Requires syringe. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Abdominal Pain, Dizziness
Tooltip_IVCiprofloxacin: IV Ciprofloxacin fluoroquinolone antibiotic. <LINE> FAST CURE for GI and respiratory bacterial infections (12hrs). <LINE> Requires IV Kit. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Tendon Weakness, Dizziness
Tooltip_TetanusImmunoglobulin: Tetanus immunoglobulin - immediate protection. <LINE> FAST CURE for tetanus (48hrs). <LINE> Requires syringe. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Injection Pain, Fever
Tooltip_RifampicinComboPack: Rifampicin combination therapy for TB. <LINE> FAST CURE for tuberculosis (14 days vs 21). <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Orange Urine, Liver Stress, Fatigue
Tooltip_IVVancomycin: IV Vancomycin - last resort antibiotic. <LINE> FAST CURE for resistant infections (48hrs). <LINE> Requires IV Kit. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Red Man Syndrome, Kidney Stress
Tooltip_EmergencySepsisKit: Emergency sepsis treatment kit. <LINE> FASTEST CURE for sepsis (24hrs). <LINE> Requires IV Kit. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Severe Fatigue, Nausea, Fever
Tooltip_GeneTherapyKit: Experimental gene therapy for Knox Virus. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.3,0.3> EXTREMELY RARE - Military research item <LINE> <LINE> Success depends on blood type compatibility. <LINE> Use Antibody Test first to check compatibility! <LINE> <LINE> <RGB:0,1,0> SUCCESS: Permanent immunity <LINE> <RGB:1,0,0> FAILURE: Instant death
Tooltip_PhalanxPills: Knox Virus suppressant medication. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> DOES NOT CURE - Resets infection progress <LINE> <LINE> Diminishing returns with each use: <LINE> 1st: Full reset | 2nd: Reset to 25% <LINE> 3rd: Reset to 50% | 4th: Reset to 75% <LINE> 5th+: No effect (body adapted) <LINE> <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: <LINE> Extreme nausea (6h), Fever (12h), <LINE> Weakened immunity (48h)
Tooltip_AntibodyTestKit: Blood compatibility test for Gene Therapy. <LINE> Tests your survival odds before using <LINE> the Gene Therapy Injector. <LINE> <LINE> Results based on blood type: <LINE> - High Compatibility (75%+) <LINE> - Moderate Compatibility (50-74%) <LINE> - Low Compatibility (25-49%) <LINE> - Critical Risk (<25%) <LINE> <LINE> Single use - consumed on use.
Tooltip_ImmunoboosterShot: Pre-exposure Knox Virus prophylaxis. <LINE> <RGB:0,1,0> Grants 24 hours of immunity <LINE> <LINE> Must be taken BEFORE getting bitten! <LINE> Does NOT help if already infected. <LINE> <LINE> 7-day cooldown between uses. <LINE> <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS (while active): <LINE> Mild nausea, Reduced stamina regen, <LINE> Occasional tremors
